hypothesis: Attempt 8's causal predecessor proxy improved broad within-user ordering, but its recent-four mean discards which past impressions were positive or negative, their recency, streak structure, scenario transitions, and how far the current session has progressed. Attempt 12 showed that adding still higher-order static user-context crosses was not supported, so the highest-value refinement is to return to the measured sequence mechanism. A fourth member that retains ordered, strictly backward multi-step session state should distinguish attention persistence, fatigue, and scenario-switching regimes that have identical parent summary rates. Conservatively blending its within-user percentile rank with the exact attempt-11 ensemble should improve both broad pair ordering and top-five placement when that information transfers, while a frozen chronological gain gate preserves the incumbent otherwise.

Persist all four boosters, selected rounds and weights, vocabulary, feature/history contracts, schema and causal-order audits, metric paths, coverage, and rank divergence. falsifier: Reject executability if a required inference field is absent; the user vocabulary is missing, unsorted, or inconsistently encoded; a tab transition, base-3 pattern, or signed streak exceeds its frozen range; any feature, model score, percentile rank, or blend is non-finite; sequence construction accesses a next/future row or loses, duplicates, or reorders an authoritative row; ensemble weights are off the frozen 1/8 grid or do not sum to one; or checkpoint-only final mode on the same label-free data_root fails to reproduce attempt predictions within controller tolerance. Treat ordered multi-step history as unsupported if fewer than 10% of chronological-holdout rows have a nonempty four-step proxy pattern or prior-tab history, if the history member has effectively zero rank divergence from the reconstructed attempt-11 blend, or if its unconstrained frozen-grid blend fails to improve reconstructed-parent chronological primary by 0.0005 and the gate sets its weight to zero. Reject practical improvement unless controller primary exceeds attempt 11's 0.6733756405957718 by the campaign's frozen epsilon. If the local gate passes but controller primary misses epsilon or falls, retain attempt 11, conclude that ordered short-horizon state overfit the three-day holdout, and do not tune windows, pattern coding, streak cap, gate, or weights from the controller result. If the gate fails, retain attempt 11 and abandon this longer causal-session refinement.
